negative_controls.description: Catalog shim (disk-resolved $ref onto receipt_core) must reject {}, unrelated blobs, and passing_tests spam.
Flipping every NEGATIVE row to POSITIVE and declaring negative_fraction=0 must be rejected by the probe-local payload schema (the generated catalog shim cannot express this).
A too-easy corpus (every POSITIVE expects usage_count top-3) must score at or above the declared floor, proving the floor is not vacuous.

baseline.why_exact_match: Subset-recall would mark every NEGATIVE as a hit because empty set is a subset of top-3. Exact-set-match makes returning popular ids on a no-fit query a miss.

inputs_observed.note: Live capability-index.json, IMP-0396 receipt, and redacted transcripts were absent. Popularity is fixture usage_count standing in for a redacted transcript census. NEGATIVE rows encode the IMP-0396 no-fit path as an empty expected set.

kappa.method: Second annotator is keyword_label() on query text only; expected_capability_ids is unread.

queries.query: Build capability-index.json from six roots and survive a NUL-named file in a root.
queries.rationale: Exact IMP-0385 crawler job: six-root enumeration plus NUL survival.

queries.query: Re-run index_build so per-root counts match an independent census to zero.
queries.rationale: Index rebuild with census parity is the index-build capability, not a web search.

queries.query: Enumerate ~/.claude/skills and repo workflows/ into a single capability-index.json from six roots.
queries.rationale: Named six-root crawl; popular file.read/shell.exec do not produce the index.

queries.query: Seed a capability root with a NUL-named file and assert the crawler does not abort.
queries.rationale: NUL-named file is the index-build regression, not generic shell.exec.

queries.query: Does the crawler writing capability-index.json from six roots survive a root containing NUL-named files?
queries.rationale: Question restates the index-build contract; expected set is that one skill.

queries.query: Scrub a planted secret-shaped token and an absolute user path from router telemetry.
queries.rationale: Privacy-scrub negative control: planted secret and path must be absent after scrub.

queries.query: Run the telemetry scrub so a planted secret-shaped token never appears in the emitted JSON.
queries.rationale: Scrubber, not web search; expected set is privacy.scrub only.

queries.query: Remove every absolute user path from a telemetry record before it leaves the estate.
queries.rationale: Absolute user path scrub is the privacy capability.

queries.query: Assert privacy-scrub drops both a secret-shaped token and a home-directory path.
queries.rationale: Paired planted controls named in IMP-0397 tests_required.

queries.query: Invoke the four-voice council skill: Architect, Skeptic, Pragmatist, Critic as static prompt sections.
queries.rationale: Named four roles; not a shell or file-read task.

queries.query: Draft a review using the four-voice council without compiling CouncilSpec policy.
queries.rationale: Council prompt skill, explicitly not an executable policy compiler.

queries.query: List the four-voice council roles Architect, Skeptic, Pragmatist, Critic for a design review.
queries.rationale: Role list is the council skill's identity.

queries.query: Read stored git blob bytes without using git archive on Windows.
queries.rationale: Provenance helper forbids git archive; popular shell.exec would pick the wrong recipe.

queries.query: Compare git cat-file, git show, and git archive on the same blob and keep the non-archive routes.
queries.rationale: Three-route blob comparison is the provenance capability.

queries.query: Replace every Windows git archive prescription with the stored git blob bytes helper.
queries.rationale: Census-and-fix of archive recipes is blob provenance, not web.search.

queries.query: Author a JSON schema that rejects a receipt missing its sentinel.
queries.rationale: Schema-authoring task; always-top-3 popular tools do not write the schema.

queries.query: Add a negative fixture proving a receipt without a sentinel is INVALID under the JSON schema that rejects a receipt missing its sentinel.
queries.rationale: Negative fixture for sentinel absence is schema.author.

queries.query: Tighten additionalProperties so a JSON schema that rejects a receipt missing its sentinel also rejects unknown keys.
queries.rationale: Contract strictness work belongs to schema.author.

queries.query: Corrupt one router description and assert the regression suite goes red.
queries.rationale: Mutation harness: one description corruption must be observed as redness.

queries.query: Delete one trigger row in the mutation harness and require the suite to fail closed.
queries.rationale: Trigger-row deletion is a named mutation, not a popular generic tool.

queries.query: Unpin the embedding model via the mutation harness and check the regression suite goes red.
queries.rationale: Fourth mutation class; expected set is the harness only.

queries.query: Edit a capability description and prove the next router call sees the change, not a stale cache.
queries.rationale: Cache invalidation on content hash plus mtime.

queries.query: Recover from a truncated cache file using content hash plus mtime rather than serving an empty index as OK.
queries.rationale: Corrupted-cache recovery is cache.invalidate, not file.read alone.

queries.query: Ban a capability that scores 0.99 and show the owner ban still excludes it.
queries.rationale: Ban-beats-score; popularity of the banned cap must not leak it back.

queries.query: Pin a capability always-on and prove the budget ceiling does not drop it.
queries.rationale: Pin-survives-budget is the override layer.

queries.query: Return typed NO-CAPABILITY-FITS with closest rejected candidates instead of injecting a weak match.
queries.rationale: No-fit terminal verdict; empty selection is explicit, not a popular tool dump.

queries.query: For a labelled no-fit query, emit NO-CAPABILITY-FITS rather than injecting a weak match from the index.
queries.rationale: IMP-0396 no-fit path encoded as a positive expected capability (the no-fit emitter).

queries.query: Search the public web for the current Python jsonschema version.
queries.rationale: Web search intent; always-top-3 returns two extra popular ids, so exact match fails.

queries.query: Read the file capability-index.json from disk.
queries.rationale: Singleton file.read; stub returns the whole popular triple.

queries.query: Run a shell command to list ~/.claude/skills.
queries.rationale: Singleton shell.exec listing; not the six-root index builder.

queries.query: What will the weather be on Mars next Tuesday?
queries.rationale: No indexed capability forecasts planetary weather; expected set empty.

queries.query: Write a sourdough starter schedule for a home kitchen.
queries.rationale: Cooking schedule is outside the capability index.

queries.query: File my 1994 US federal tax return as if paper forms were still required.
queries.rationale: Historical tax filing is not a router capability.

queries.query: Recommend a pediatric dentist in Reykjavik.
queries.rationale: Local medical referral is not in the indexed repertoire.

queries.query: Tune a piano to A440 in a concert hall.
queries.rationale: Instrument tuning is not a capability in this index.

queries.query: Diagnose a rash on a golden retriever from a photo.
queries.rationale: Veterinary diagnosis is outside the estate.

queries.query: Plan a wedding seating chart for 180 guests.
queries.rationale: Event seating is not an indexed skill, command, or workflow.

queries.query: Translate this restaurant menu into conversational Klingon.
queries.rationale: Constructed-language menu translation is not indexed.

queries.query: What time does the ferry leave Nantucket in 2003?
queries.rationale: Historical ferry timetable is not a live capability.

queries.query: Calculate the batting average of a fictional baseball player.
queries.rationale: Fictional sports stats are not a repertoire item.

queries.query: How do I darn a wool sock with a wooden mushroom?
queries.rationale: Textile repair is not in capability-index.json.

queries.query: Name three edible mosses on the Isle of Skye in winter.
queries.rationale: Foraging advice is a no-fit; expected set must stay empty.

report.question: Build the labelled router regression corpus: query, expected capability set, and rationale - with at least 25 percent NEGATIVE queries whose expected set is empty. Exact target: a corpus that cannot be satisfied by a router that always returns the top-3 most popular capabilities.
report.title: Router regression corpus with mandatory negative queries
